events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in rural New York, beginning on August 15, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: 57 years since the legendary Woodstock Festival kicked off! What's the one song that takes you straight back to the summer of '69?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the 'King of Rock and Roll', passed away in Memphis, Tennessee, on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock and Roll
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His music lives on forever. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Influential American rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, whose powerful music and lyrics continue to resonate decades later. What's your go-to Tupac anthem?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London in 1970 at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'! That cover, that music... pure genius. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde was born in Akron, Ohio, on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Lead singer of The Pretenders and an absolute rock icon. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher was born in Manchester, England, on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The voice of a generation. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine' on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon's timeless album 'Imagine' was released. Its message of peace and unity resonates now more than ever. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple introduced its first iPod portable music player on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: Remember the iPod?
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It changed how we listened to music forever! What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 movie moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon was born in Liverpool, England, on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese was born in Weston-super-Mare, England, on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'! A sprawling masterpiece of diverse sounds. What's your hidden gem from the album?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in London on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury. A voice and stage presence that defined an era. What's your favourite Queen song or Freddie moment?
